# snipeit_license (Data Source)

Looks up a single license by `id` or exact `name`. Exactly one of these must be set.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "snipeit_license" "by_name" {
  name = "Office Suite"
}

data "snipeit_license" "by_id" {
  id = 7
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) Numeric id of the license.
- `name` (String) Exact name of the license to look up.

### Read-Only

- `category_id` (Number) Id of the category.
- `company_id` (Number) Id of the owning company.
- `expiration_date` (String) Expiration date (`YYYY-MM-DD`).
- `free_seats_count` (Number) Number of unassigned seats.
- `license_email` (String) Email of the licensee.
- `license_name` (String) Name of the licensee.
- `maintained` (Boolean) Whether the license is maintained.
- `manufacturer_id` (Number) Id of the manufacturer.
- `notes` (String) Free-form notes.
- `order_number` (String) Order number of the purchase.
- `purchase_date` (String) Purchase date (`YYYY-MM-DD`).
- `purchase_order` (String) Purchase order number.
- `reassignable` (Boolean) Whether seats can be reassigned.
- `seats` (Number) Number of seats.
- `serial` (String) Product key / serial.
- `supplier_id` (Number) Id of the supplier.
- `termination_date` (String) Termination date (`YYYY-MM-DD`).
